Bug_Title: NP: Possible null pointer dereference in method on exception path (NP_NULL_ON_SOME_PATH_EXCEPTION)
Bug_Details:
A reference value which is null on some exception control path is
dereferenced here.  This may lead to a NullPointerException
when the code is executed. 
Note that because SpotBugs currently does not prune infeasible exception paths,
this may be a false warning.  Also note that SpotBugs considers the default case of a switch statement to
be an exception path, since the default case is often infeasible. NullPointerException
Bug_Explanation: The null reference `s` is dereferenced on the exception path. It is assigned a value (a string) only in the catch clause and thrown an exception immediately afterward. The exception is caught, but the null reference is still dereferenced before returning from the method, which leads to a NullPointerException.
Trigger_Explanation: The test case triggers the bug by calling the showBug method. This method throws a NullPointerException and assigns a value to the String `s` within the catch block. However, before returning from the method, the method tries to access the `s` variable, causing a NullPointerException.
